test_sql_injection_attempt.title: Verify login rejects SQL injection payload

steps.action: Log in to the application with valid credentials
steps.expected: User is logged in and default page loads

steps.action: Navigate to Login page > Security - Injection
steps.expected: Security - Injection page loads without errors

steps.action: Locate the form, input, or control where validation applies
steps.expected: The target input or form is visible

steps.action: Enter invalid data or trigger the error condition for SQL injection attempt
steps.expected: The invalid input is accepted into the field

steps.action: Attempt to submit or trigger the validation
steps.expected: Validation fires on submit or field blur

steps.action: Verify an error message is displayed near the field or at the top of the form
steps.expected: A clear, descriptive error message appears

steps.action: Verify the error message text is correct and helpful
steps.expected: Error message accurately describes the validation failure

steps.action: Verify the form did not submit or the action was blocked
steps.expected: No data was saved; the user remains on the form

steps.action: Correct the invalid input with valid data
steps.expected: The error message disappears when valid data is entered

steps.action: Set up precondition: on login
steps.expected: Precondition is met (on login)

steps.action: Submit with the corrected data and verify success
steps.expected: Form submits successfully after correction

test_xss_attempt.title: Verify login rejects XSS script payload

steps.action: Open the application login page
steps.expected: Login page loads with username and password fields

steps.action: Log in with the required user role/credentials
steps.expected: User is authenticated and redirected to the default page

steps.action: Navigate to Admin > Licenses
steps.expected: Licenses page loads (or access denied, depending on the test)

steps.action: Verify the access behavior matches the expected permission level
steps.expected: User can access or is correctly blocked from the feature

steps.action: Verify non-Admin license access attempt is logged
steps.expected: Non-admin license access attempt logged

steps.action: Verify no unauthorized data or controls are exposed
steps.expected: Only permitted content is visible to the current user role

steps.action: Log out and verify the session ends cleanly
steps.expected: User is redirected to the login page after logout

steps.action: Navigate to the login page
steps.expected: Login page is displayed

steps.action: Enter a valid email with a 3-character password and submit
steps.expected: Login fails with error or validation message
